title: Events, not requests
description: An event records that something happened, and the publisher does not know who consumes it.

title: Independent consumers
description: Each consumer handles the event on its own schedule, so one slow consumer cannot block the publisher.

title: Background work
description: The request returns once the event is stored, and workers do the slow work later.

title: Eventual consistency
description: Events trade immediate consistency for independent retries, so the UI shows processing states and consumers stay idempotent.
